label: Bible Study
prompt: Thy words were found, and I did _____ them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
verse: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
note: Jeremiah devoured God's words like a feast — Ezekiel and John both eat scrolls later.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Some trust in _____, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
verse: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
note: Some trust in chariots and some in horses; David's people bring something better — the name of the LORD.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the _____?
verse: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
note: Ten lepers healed, one came back to say thank you — and Jesus noticed the missing nine.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much _____ enter into the kingdom of God.
verse: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
note: Paul said this soon after being stoned at Lystra and left for dead — he wasn't speaking hypothetically.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Thanks be unto God for his _____ gift.
verse: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
note: Paul ends two chapters about giving money by pointing to the one gift words can't describe — 'unspeakable.'
